DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Interstitial Nephritis (AIN)

The presence of eosinophiluria (Hansel stain) combined with leukocyturia, negative bacterial culture, and elevated creatinine suggests an allergic reaction to the recent antibiotics rather than bacterial pyelonephritis. I am confirming the diagnosis based on this evidence.
